title: Multi-Test Pricing Schedule for Genetic Self-Pay Quotes
content:
When several tests stand on one self-pay Laboratory Test Orders accession of the Hereditary & Reproductive Genetic Testing class, each test's price within the test price sum of the genetic self-pay quote is set as follows. Tests are counted when they are charged on the accession with an *ordered* charge line and not credited.

| Tests standing on the accession | Highest-priced test | Every other test |
|---|---|---|
| Three or more | Keeps its full self-pay price | Priced at 25 percent of its self-pay price |
| Exactly two | Keeps its full self-pay price (the higher-priced test) | Priced at 50 percent of its self-pay price (the other test) |
| One | Keeps its full self-pay price | — |

**Clause.** When three or more such tests stand on the accession, the highest-priced test keeps its full self-pay price and every other test is priced at 25 percent of its self-pay price. When exactly two such tests stand on the accession, the higher-priced test keeps its full self-pay price and the other is priced at 50 percent of its self-pay price. A single test keeps its full self-pay price.

**Test price sum (hypothetical self-pay prices).**

- Two tests at 300.00 and 200.00: 300.00 plus 50 percent of 200.00, that is 400.00.
- Three tests at 300.00, 250.00 and 200.00: 300.00 plus 25 percent of 250.00 plus 25 percent of 200.00, that is 412.50.
- One test at 300.00: 300.00.

**Points of judgement.**

- *Two tests at the same price.* One of them keeps its full price and the other takes the share; the sum is the same whichever is chosen.
- *An add-on line.* Only tests charged with an ordered charge line count here; an add-on line is not an ordered charge line.
- *A credited ordered line.* A test whose ordered line has been credited no longer stands and is not counted.
